verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a hosted API service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe confirms an official MCP server is documented at github.com/jina-ai/MCP, but the pack has no detail on which Reader or Search capabilities it exposes, how agents connect, or how auth works. Missing for 10: documentation of the exposed MCP tools (read/search), setup and connection instructions, auth details, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://github.com/jina-ai/MCP
